'''Erk Zallis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]. He was hired by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to work at the [[Jedi Temple carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon freezing chamber]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Zallis operated the [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon freezing]] device and froze several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The Republic elite team needed to avoid life form scan by being frozen to infiltrate the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Erk Zallis' first and only appearance thus far was in "[[The Citadel (episode)|The Citadel]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode, which aired on [[February 14]], [[2011]],<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode318.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Citadel}}</ref> did not mention his name; however, a [[Clone Cards|Clone Card]] on [[StarWars.com]] named the Ugnaught Erk Zallis.<ref name="cc">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_erkzallis.jpg|text=Clone Card: Erk Zallis|nobackup=1}}</ref>
